binding: The evaluator loads the actual canonical item, checks its full item digest and exact four-field projection, and binds exact formal/ambient/decoded/retrieval payloads. Top and row fields are allowlisted.
detected_issue: A source-aware packet embedded the complete canonical QA item, including historical QA review metadata. The exposed current-cohort pass was retained only as a nonqualifying diagnostic; no canonical acceptance file was written by that reviewer.
formal_provenance_boundary: Source-blind decoder version-wrapper provenance is permitted formal-only context. It is not a prior source-aware alignment judgement and cannot be used as evidence of source fidelity.
not_proven_by_schema: Actual operational blindness or reviewer identity/authenticity
Mathematical truth, whole-question coverage, proof-method fidelity or whole-module source review
second_cohort_policy: Frozen original packet/report/Lean receipts remain unchanged. The latest cumulative reader additionally requires a fresh sanitized source-alignment supplement for all four second-cohort roots. That is not another Lean replay.
